definition: Denis Yarats (born 1987) is a computer scientist and entrepreneur, best known as the co-founder and Chief Technology Officer (CTO) of Perplexity AI, an AI-powered search engine launched in 2022.
details: Created DrQ for sample-efficient visual reinforcement learning at NYU and Meta AI, and architected Perplexity's real-time retrieval and inference engine.

explainer.lead: Denis Yarats is a Computer scientist.

contributions.name: His work during this time focused on developing scalable algorithms for learning and decision-making in complex environments.

timeline.what: Yarats worked in Seattle as a Software Development Engineer at Microsoft from 2011 to 2013, where he worked on the Bing search engine.
